schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be 2 for this format.

providers.description: Ordered list of configured skill repository providers.

resources.description: Declared resources (for pinning). May be empty; resources can be installed without a declaration.

id.description: Unique short name for this provider within the project.

repository_id.description: Provider-specific repository identifier (e.g., owner/repo for GitHub).

catalog_ref.description: The Git branch, tag, or commit SHA of the catalog in the remote repository.

catalog_path.description: Path to the SKILLS.md catalog file within the repository.

target_dir.description: Project-relative directory where resources from this provider are installed.

resource_name.description: Stable identity of the resource, matching the catalog_id format (type::folder::name).

provider_id.description: References the id of a ProviderEntry in the providers array.

pinned_version.description: Optional commit SHA or tag to lock this resource to. Empty or absent means unpinned.
